description: Synthetic morphine in a grey gelcap. The pain goes away. So does everything else.

overdose.message: Your breathing slows, and slows, and forgets how.

phases.comeup_message: A warm grey tide rolls up from your feet. Nothing hurts.
phases.end_message: The warmth recedes and leaves you cold and small on the shore.
phases.peak_message: You're floating in warm water in a dark, kind room.

withdrawal.message: Your skin crawls, your bones ache, and the whole world is a hand held out for more grey.

stages.easing: It steps back far enough to be looked at, which isn't the same as going.
stages.onset: A cold spot opens between your shoulder blades and stays there.
stages.peak: The pain grey was taking is all still there and has been the whole time, waiting, with interest on it.
stages.rising: Every joint you own reports in. Nothing is injured. Everything is present.
stages.tail: You're functional and about a quarter of you is somewhere else, listening for it.

name: grey
